source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.8.0, data build 981, released 2026-10-14

data.summary:
This model can carry up to 6 models, all **ADEPTA SORORITAS INFANTRY**, excluding **JUMP PACK** models and the **TRIUMPH OF SAINT KATHERINE**.

As the Declare Battle Formations step begins, you may split 1 **BATTLE SISTERS SQUAD**, **DOMINION SQUAD** or **SISTERS NOVITIATE SQUAD** in your army into two units:

- Make the two halves as equal in model count as possible, and note which models form each.
- If the split unit has the Cherub ability, just one of the halves may use Cherub during the battle. Record which one.
- One half must begin the battle embarked in this **TRANSPORT**.
- The other half may begin embarked in another **TRANSPORT** or be set up on its own.

splitUnit.when: start of the Declare Battle Formations step

otherMay: be deployed as a separate unit
